vocabulary.meaningVi: phương án dự phòng; tình huống bất ngờ
vocabulary.definitionEn: A future event that may happen, or a plan prepared for it.
vocabulary.example: The budget includes a ten per cent contingency for delays.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Ngân sách có khoản dự phòng mười phần trăm cho các chậm trễ.

vocabulary.meaningVi: miễn, bỏ qua (quyền hoặc khoản phí)
vocabulary.definitionEn: To decide not to apply a rule, fee or right.
vocabulary.example: The bank agreed to waive the transfer fee for corporate clients.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Ngân hàng đồng ý miễn phí chuyển khoản cho khách hàng doanh nghiệp.

vocabulary.meaningVi: quy định rõ trong hợp đồng
vocabulary.definitionEn: To state clearly that something must be done, especially in an agreement.
vocabulary.example: The lease stipulates that repairs are the tenant's responsibility.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Hợp đồng thuê quy định rõ việc sửa chữa thuộc trách nhiệm bên thuê.

vocabulary.definitionEn: A difference between two things that should be the same.
vocabulary.example: There is a discrepancy between the invoice and the delivery note.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Có sự chênh lệch giữa hoá đơn và phiếu giao hàng.

vocabulary.definitionEn: To make a process happen more quickly.
vocabulary.example: We can expedite the order for an additional fee.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Chúng tôi có thể đẩy nhanh đơn hàng với một khoản phí thêm.

vocabulary.definitionEn: A condition in an agreement, or the act of supplying something.
vocabulary.example: A provision in the contract allows either side to withdraw after a year.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Một điều khoản trong hợp đồng cho phép hai bên rút sau một năm.

vocabulary.definitionEn: To combine several things into one more effective whole.
vocabulary.example: The company consolidated three warehouses into a single facility.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Công ty gộp ba kho thành một cơ sở duy nhất.

vocabulary.definitionEn: Legal responsibility for something, especially for costs or damage.
vocabulary.example: The clause limits our liability to the value of the order.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Điều khoản này giới hạn trách nhiệm của chúng tôi ở mức giá trị đơn hàng.

vocabulary.definitionEn: Something that must exist or happen before something else is possible.
vocabulary.example: A signed confidentiality agreement is a prerequisite for site access.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Thoả thuận bảo mật đã ký là điều kiện tiên quyết để vào công trường.

vocabulary.definitionEn: To delay something until a later time.
vocabulary.example: The board deferred the decision until the audit was complete.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Hội đồng hoãn quyết định cho tới khi kiểm toán xong.

vocabulary.meaningVi: phải chịu, gánh (chi phí, tổn thất)
vocabulary.definitionEn: To experience a cost or loss as a result of something you do.
vocabulary.example: Late cancellations incur a charge of fifty per cent.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Huỷ muộn sẽ phải chịu khoản phí bằng năm mươi phần trăm.

vocabulary.meaningVi: giảm nhẹ, hạn chế tác hại
vocabulary.definitionEn: To make something less severe or damaging.
vocabulary.example: Holding extra stock mitigates the risk of supply interruption.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Giữ thêm hàng tồn giúp giảm nhẹ rủi ro gián đoạn nguồn cung.

activities.title: Part 1 — Photographs
activities.format: TOEIC Listening — Part 1 · Photographs, 6 câu, bốn lựa chọn, chỉ nghe không có chữ
activities.instructionsVi: Ở mục tiêu 800, các phương án sai dùng từ vựng ít gặp và mô tả đúng một phần bức ảnh. Phân biệt được đòi hỏi nghe rõ cả động từ lẫn giới từ chỉ vị trí.
activities.promptEn:
Look at each photograph and listen to the four statements. Select the statement that best describes what you see.

PHOTO 1: A florist's shop. Buckets of cut flowers stand on the pavement outside. Inside the doorway, a woman is wrapping a bouquet in paper. No customer is visible.

PHOTO 2: A rooftop with solar panels. Two technicians kneel beside one panel; one holds a tablet, the other is tightening a bracket with a spanner. Cables run along the roof edge.

PHOTO 3: A hospital corridor. A trolley loaded with linen has been left against the wall. A sign on a stand reads 'Wet floor'. Nobody is walking through.

PHOTO 4: A busy bakery counter seen from the customer's side. Behind the glass, trays of bread are stacked three high. An assistant reaches into the display with tongs.

PHOTO 5: A conference registration desk. Name badges are laid out in rows on the table. Two staff members stand behind it, one checking a list, the other looking towards the entrance.

PHOTO 6: A riverside path. A bench faces the water. On the bench, a folded newspaper and a coffee cup have been left; no one is sitting down.

transcript.speaker: Photo 1
transcript.text: (A) She's watering the flowers. (B) Flowers are being delivered. (C) She's wrapping a bouquet. (D) A customer is paying at the counter.

transcript.speaker: Photo 2
transcript.text: (A) Panels are being installed on the ground. (B) One of the technicians is tightening a bracket. (C) They're rolling up the cables. (D) The roof is being cleaned.

transcript.speaker: Photo 3
transcript.text: (A) A trolley is being pushed along the corridor. (B) The floor is being mopped. (C) A trolley has been left against the wall. (D) Patients are queuing in the corridor.

transcript.speaker: Photo 4
transcript.text: (A) The display case is empty. (B) An assistant is reaching into the display. (C) Bread is being taken out of an oven. (D) Customers are being served coffee.

transcript.speaker: Photo 5
transcript.text: (A) Delegates are collecting their badges. (B) Badges have been arranged on the table. (C) The desk is being assembled. (D) A list is being printed.

transcript.speaker: Photo 6
transcript.text: (A) Someone is reading on the bench. (B) The bench is being repainted. (C) Items have been left on a bench. (D) A cup is being filled.

questions.prompt: Photo 1

options.text: A customer is paying at the counter.

questions.explanationVi: Ảnh ghi rõ không có khách nào, nên (D) loại. Hoa đứng sẵn trong xô, không ai đang giao — (C) là bẫy dùng đúng chủ đề nhưng sai hành động.

questions.prompt: Photo 2

options.text: Panels are being installed on the ground.
One of the technicians is tightening a bracket.

questions.explanationVi: Cáp CHẠY dọc mép mái, không ai cuộn lại. (A) sai ở giới từ vị trí: công việc diễn ra trên mái, không phải dưới đất.

questions.prompt: Photo 3

options.text: A trolley is being pushed along the corridor.
A trolley has been left against the wall.
Patients are queuing in the corridor.

questions.explanationVi: Không có ai trong hành lang, nên mọi phương án bị động tiếp diễn đều sai. Biển 'Wet floor' không có nghĩa là đang có người lau — (B) là bẫy suy diễn.

questions.prompt: Photo 4

options.text: An assistant is reaching into the display.
Bread is being taken out of an oven.

questions.explanationVi: (A) trái với ảnh (bánh xếp ba tầng). (C) đổi 'display' thành 'oven' — bẫy đổi địa điểm trong cùng bối cảnh.

questions.prompt: Photo 5

options.text: Badges have been arranged on the table.

questions.explanationVi: Thẻ tên đã bày sẵn thành hàng, chưa ai tới lấy. Nhân viên đang KIỂM TRA danh sách chứ không in — (C) sai động từ.

questions.prompt: Photo 6

options.text: Someone is reading on the bench.
Items have been left on a bench.

questions.explanationVi: Báo đã GẤP và không có ai ngồi, nên (A) loại. Ảnh không người thì đáp án gần như luôn ở hoàn thành bị động.

activities.title: Part 2 — Question–Response
activities.format: TOEIC Listening — Part 2 · Question–Response, 25 câu, ba lựa chọn, chỉ nghe không có chữ
activities.instructionsVi: Ở mục tiêu 800, đáp án đúng thường GIÁN TIẾP — không trả lời thẳng câu hỏi nhưng vẫn hợp lý trong hội thoại thật. Đừng loại một phương án chỉ vì nó không trả lời đúng loại câu hỏi.
activities.promptEn: You will hear a question or statement followed by three responses. Choose the most appropriate response for each of the 25 items.

transcript.text: Has the revised floor plan gone to the client yet?
Where did you put the signed contracts?
This printer seems to be jammed again.
Would you rather present first or after the break?
I assume the Hartwell paperwork is finished.
Why has the launch date slipped again?
Do you know how much the refit is going to cost?
Shouldn't the auditors have finished by now?
Who's covering the depot while Rob's away?
The heating in the west wing still isn't working.
Could we bring the review forward a week?
How did the client take the news about the delay?
You've seen the revised figures, haven't you?
Is there a reason the second shift finished early?
Where do we stand on the Kirby tender?
I thought we'd agreed to drop that supplier.
Should the samples go by courier or by post?
That's the third time this month the system's gone down.
When are we expecting the inspection report?
Do you happen to know if Priya's back from leave?
The figures in section four don't add up.
Would you mind if I moved our one-to-one to Thursday?
How long has this account been overdue?
Wasn't the training supposed to be online?
What made you decide against the Meadow Road site?

questions.prompt: 7. Has the revised floor plan gone to the client yet?

options.text: The client is on the third floor.

questions.explanationVi: Trả lời gián tiếp: người khác phụ trách nên tôi không biết. (A) lặp 'floor', (C) lặp 'plan' — bẫy lặp từ.

questions.prompt: 8. Where did you put the signed contracts?
questions.explanationVi: Trả lời bằng câu hỏi ngược là hợp lệ và rất hay gặp ở mức cao. (B) trả lời thời gian cho câu hỏi 'Where'.

questions.prompt: 9. This printer seems to be jammed again.

options.text: There's another one on the second floor.

questions.explanationVi: Câu trần thuật nêu vấn đề, phản hồi hợp lý là gợi ý giải pháp.

questions.prompt: 10. Would you rather present first or after the break?
questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi lựa chọn có thể trả lời 'sao cũng được'. Đây là dạng thí sinh mức trung hay loại nhầm.

questions.prompt: 11. I assume the Hartwell paperwork is finished.

options.text: Their legal team is still reading it.

questions.explanationVi: Câu trần thuật nêu giả định; phản hồi đúng là đính chính gián tiếp. (A) lặp gốc từ 'finish'.

questions.prompt: 12. Why has the launch date slipped again?

options.text: In the second week of June.

questions.explanationVi: Chuyển câu hỏi sang bên chịu trách nhiệm là trả lời gián tiếp hợp lệ, có kèm chút bực bội — rất tự nhiên trong hội thoại thật.

questions.prompt: 13. Do you know how much the refit is going to cost?

options.text: The quotes come in on Friday.

questions.explanationVi: 'Chưa biết, phải đợi báo giá' là cách trả lời gián tiếp. (C) lặp gốc từ 'refit'.

questions.prompt: 14. Shouldn't the auditors have finished by now?

options.text: They asked for two more days.

questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi phủ định thể hiện sốt ruột, cần lời giải thích. (B) trả lời số lượng, (C) trả lời thời điểm khác.

questions.prompt: 15. Who's covering the depot while Rob's away?

options.text: The depot is on Wren Street.

questions.explanationVi: 'Tôi cũng không biết' là đáp án đúng hợp lệ. (A) và (B) lặp từ khoá mà không trả lời 'who'.

questions.prompt: 16. The heating in the west wing still isn't working.
questions.explanationVi: Câu than phiền cần phản hồi cho biết đang xử lý. (B) lảng tránh vấn đề, (C) lặp 'west wing'.

questions.prompt: 17. Could we bring the review forward a week?

options.text: I'd have to check with the panel.

questions.explanationVi: Yêu cầu được đáp bằng 'phải hỏi lại đã'. (B) hiểu 'forward' theo nghĩa chuyển tiếp email — bẫy đa nghĩa.

questions.prompt: 18. How did the client take the news about the delay?
questions.explanationVi: 'How did they take it' hỏi PHẢN ỨNG, không hỏi phương tiện. (A) hiểu 'how' theo nghĩa cách thức — bẫy tinh vi nhất nhóm này.

questions.prompt: 19. You've seen the revised figures, haven't you?

options.text: The figure is on page four.

questions.explanationVi: Trả lời một phần là dạng đáp án đúng rất hay gặp ở mức 800. (A) đổi vai người thực hiện.

questions.prompt: 20. Is there a reason the second shift finished early?

options.text: The line was down from four.

questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi lý do được trả lời bằng sự việc gây ra nó. (A) và (B) bám vào từ 'shift/second'.

questions.prompt: 21. Where do we stand on the Kirby tender?

options.text: Kirby is about forty minutes away.

questions.explanationVi: 'Where do we stand' là thành ngữ hỏi tiến độ, không hỏi vị trí. (B) hiểu theo nghĩa đen — bẫy thành ngữ.

questions.prompt: 22. I thought we'd agreed to drop that supplier.

options.text: We did, but their price came down.

questions.explanationVi: Câu trần thuật nêu mâu thuẫn, cần lời giải thích. (A) hiểu 'drop' theo nghĩa đánh rơi.

questions.prompt: 23. Should the samples go by courier or by post?

options.text: The post office closes at five.

questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi lựa chọn trả lời bằng tiêu chí thay vì chọn cứng một bên — dạng đáp án đúng ở mức cao.

questions.prompt: 24. That's the third time this month the system's gone down.

options.text: The system is on the third floor.
I know, IT are meeting about it tomorrow.

questions.explanationVi: Câu than phiền cần phản hồi đồng cảm kèm thông tin. (A) và (B) bám vào 'third/three'.

questions.prompt: 25. When are we expecting the inspection report?

options.text: The inspector was here on Tuesday.

questions.explanationVi: 'When' cần mốc thời gian. (B) trả lời khi thanh tra ĐẾN, không phải khi báo cáo về — bẫy đổi sự kiện.

questions.prompt: 26. Do you happen to know if Priya's back from leave?
questions.explanationVi: Suy ra câu trả lời từ một dấu hiệu gián tiếp. (A) lặp gốc từ 'leave/left' theo nghĩa khác.

questions.prompt: 27. The figures in section four don't add up.

options.text: I noticed that too — I've flagged it.

questions.explanationVi: Câu nêu vấn đề cần phản hồi xác nhận. (C) hiểu 'add up' theo nghĩa đen cộng số.

questions.prompt: 28. Would you mind if I moved our one-to-one to Thursday?

options.text: Not at all — Thursday's clearer for me anyway.

questions.explanationVi: 'Would you mind if…' trả lời 'Not at all' nghĩa là đồng ý. (A) lặp gốc từ 'move'.

questions.prompt: 29. How long has this account been overdue?
questions.explanationVi: 'How long' cần khoảng thời gian. (C) lặp âm 'overdue/overdraft' — bẫy gần âm.

questions.prompt: 30. Wasn't the training supposed to be online?

options.text: They changed it after the trial run.

questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi phủ định kiểm chứng lại kế hoạch, cần lời giải thích. (A) lặp âm 'online/line'.

questions.prompt: 31. What made you decide against the Meadow Road site?
questions.explanationVi: 'What made you decide' hỏi LÝ DO. (B) trả lời thời điểm quyết định, không phải nguyên nhân.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 1: renegotiating a maintenance contract
activities.instructionsVi: Ở mục tiêu 800, Part 3 có câu hỏi về hàm ý của một câu nói cụ thể, không chỉ hỏi sự việc.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 32 through 34.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Thanks for seeing me. We'd like to extend the maintenance contract, but your quote is well above what we budgeted.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: What figure did you have in mind?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: About ninety thousand a year. Your quote is a hundred and twelve.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: I can't reach ninety at the current service level. That would mean losing the four-hour response guarantee, and I don't think you'd want that.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: No — the response time is the reason we're with you.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Then let's look at scope instead. You have quarterly inspections at all fourteen sites. Half of them have had no issues in three years. Move those to twice a year and I can get to ninety-eight.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Ninety-eight I could defend internally. Send me the list of sites you'd reclassify and I'll take it to the finance committee.

questions.prompt: 32. What is the main obstacle?

options.text: The response guarantee is too slow.
The quoted price exceeds the budget.

questions.explanationVi: 'your quote is well above what we budgeted' — 112 so với 90 nghìn.

questions.prompt: 33. What does the woman mean when she says, 'I don't think you'd want that'?

options.text: The client should reduce the number of sites.
She is refusing to negotiate further.
The client would reject a slower response time.
She doubts the client can pay.

questions.explanationVi: Câu trước nói giá 90 nghìn đồng nghĩa mất bảo đảm phản hồi 4 giờ; người đàn ông xác nhận ngay sau đó.

questions.prompt: 34. What will the man do next?

options.text: Take a revised proposal to a committee

questions.explanationVi: 'I'll take it to the finance committee' sau khi nhận danh sách các điểm được phân loại lại.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 2: an audit finding
activities.format: TOEIC Listening — Part 3 · Conversation 2, ba người nói (câu 35–37)
activities.instructionsVi: Ba người nói, có nói giảm mang tính mỉa. Nghĩa thật thường ngược với nghĩa đen của câu chữ.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation among three speakers and answer questions 35 through 37.

transcript.speaker: W1
transcript.text: The auditors have flagged the approvals process. Fourteen purchases over the threshold went through without a second signature.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Fourteen out of how many? Fourteen out of nine hundred is a different conversation from fourteen out of twenty.

transcript.speaker: W1
transcript.text: Fourteen out of thirty-one.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Ah. Well, that's certainly a number.

transcript.speaker: W2
transcript.text: In fairness, the second-signature rule only came in during March and nobody was told. I found out because I read the intranet, which I don't think anyone else does.

transcript.speaker: W1
transcript.text: That's a reasonable point, and it changes what we recommend. If the rule wasn't communicated, the finding is about our rollout, not about people ignoring controls.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I'd still want the fourteen reviewed individually before we conclude that.

questions.prompt: 35. What does the man mean by 'that's certainly a number'?

options.text: He believes the audit was inaccurate.
He thinks the proportion is alarmingly high.

questions.explanationVi: Nói giảm mang tính mỉa. Ông ta vừa lập luận rằng tỉ lệ mới quan trọng; 14 trên 31 là gần một nửa.

questions.prompt: 36. What point does the second woman make?

options.text: The auditors reviewed the wrong period.
Staff were not informed when the rule changed.

questions.explanationVi: 'the second-signature rule only came in during March and nobody was told'.

questions.prompt: 37. Why does the man still want the cases reviewed?

options.text: In case some are irregular for other reasons
To prepare a report for the intranet

questions.explanationVi: 'I'd still want the fourteen reviewed individually before we conclude that' — tức trước khi kết luận nguyên nhân chỉ là do phổ biến kém.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 3: a warranty claim
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Có một điều khoản kèm ngoại lệ; câu hỏi nhắm đúng vào ngoại lệ.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 38 through 40.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: I'm calling about a compressor that failed. It's two years and one month old, so I assume we're outside warranty.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Standard cover is twenty-four months, yes. But do you hold an annual service plan?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: We do — both services completed on time.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Then you're on the extended term, which is thirty-six months. You're still covered.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: There's one complication. The chamber reached forty-six degrees overnight, and I know there's an exclusion above forty.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: There is. But why did it reach forty-six?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: The thermostat stopped regulating. It's your unit — supplied with the compressor.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Then the exclusion doesn't apply. There's a clause covering excursions caused by our own equipment. Submit the claim and reference the thermostat.

questions.prompt: 38. Why is the unit still under warranty?

options.text: The fault was reported within 30 days.
The customer is a long-standing client.
The customer holds a service plan with all services completed.

questions.explanationVi: Gói bảo dưỡng năm kéo dài cover từ 24 lên 36 tháng, và cả hai lần bảo dưỡng đều hoàn thành.

questions.prompt: 39. Why does the temperature exclusion not apply?

options.text: 46 degrees is within the permitted range.
It was caused by the supplier's own thermostat.
The exclusion was removed last year.

questions.explanationVi: 'There's a clause covering excursions caused by our own equipment'.

questions.prompt: 40. What is the woman told to do?

options.text: Submit a claim referencing the thermostat
Wait for an engineer to call

questions.explanationVi: 'Submit the claim and reference the thermostat'.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 4: a hiring dilemma
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Hai bên có quan điểm khác nhau và cùng thừa nhận điểm mạnh của phía kia.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 41 through 43.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: We're down to two for the analyst role. Mensah has the stronger technical test; Vasquez interviews better.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: How much stronger on the test?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Substantially. Ninety-one against sixty-eight.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: That's not a small gap. My hesitation is that this role spends half its time explaining findings to people who don't want to hear them, and the test doesn't measure that at all.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Agreed. Though I'd rather teach communication to someone who can do the analysis than teach analysis to someone who can't.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: That's fair. Let's offer Mensah, but I'd want a development plan for the presenting side written into the first six months.

questions.prompt: 41. What is the woman's concern about Ms Mensah?

options.text: Her technical score is too low.
She is unavailable for six months.
The test does not measure communication.

questions.explanationVi: 'this role spends half its time explaining findings… and the test doesn't measure that at all'.

questions.prompt: 42. What is the man's argument?

options.text: The interview matters more than the test.
Communication is easier to teach than analysis.

questions.explanationVi: 'I'd rather teach communication to someone who can do the analysis than teach analysis to someone who can't'.

questions.prompt: 43. What condition does the woman attach to the offer?

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 10: assessing a supplier risk
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Người nói bác bỏ một cách hiểu phổ biến trước khi đưa ra cách hiểu đúng.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 59 through 61.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Northline supply eighty per cent of our brackets. Everyone says that's too concentrated.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Concentration isn't the risk, though. Substitutability is.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Meaning?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: If Northline stopped tomorrow, how long to qualify another supplier for the same part? If it's two weeks, eighty per cent is fine. If it's nine months, then even forty per cent would worry me.

transcript.text: It's about five months, realistically. Tooling and approval.

How long it would take to qualify a replacement

Splitting the volume between two suppliers

questions.explanationVi: 'the answer isn't to split the volume — that just costs us the discount. It's to qualify a second supplier now and keep them warm'.

questions.prompt: 88. Why must the specification be signed off before the frame is complete?

options.text: The electrical routing depends on it.
The survey has to be repeated otherwise.

questions.explanationVi: 'signed off before the frame is complete, not after — the electrical routing depends on it'.

activities.title: Part 4 — Talk 7: museum orientation
activities.instructionsVi: Bài mở đầu tham quan. Điều được phép và điều bị cấm nằm sát nhau trong cùng một câu.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the orientation talk and answer questions 89 through 91.

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: Welcome to the Riverside Industrial Museum. I'll keep this short so you have time in the galleries.

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: Three floors. Ground floor is the mills, first floor is the people who worked in them, second floor is temporary exhibitions — currently photography from the 1930s.

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: One change from your leaflet: the working loom demonstration is no longer at three. It now runs twice, at half eleven and at two, and lasts about twenty minutes.

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: Photography is welcome throughout, but switch your flash off on the second floor — the prints up there are light-sensitive.

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: The lift reaches the first floor only. For step-free access to the second, speak to any staff member in a green lanyard and they'll take you up in the service lift.

questions.prompt: 89. When does the loom demonstration now run?

options.text: At half eleven and at two

questions.explanationVi: 'It now runs twice, at half eleven and at two'. Ba giờ là giờ CŨ in trên tờ rơi.

questions.prompt: 90. What rule applies to photography?

options.text: It is allowed, but without flash on the second floor.
It is banned throughout the museum.
It is allowed on the ground floor only.

questions.explanationVi: 'Photography is welcome throughout, but switch your flash off on the second floor'.

questions.prompt: 91. How can a visitor reach the second floor without stairs?

options.text: The main lift goes to all floors.
By asking a staff member in a green lanyard

questions.explanationVi: 'The lift reaches the first floor only… speak to any staff member in a green lanyard'.

activities.title: Part 4 — Talk 8: service advertisement
activities.instructionsVi: Quảng cáo có nhiều điều kiện loại trừ ở cuối, nói rất nhanh.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the advertisement and answer questions 92 through 94.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: Is your accounts team still chasing paper invoices? Kestrel Ledger can take that off your desk.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: We handle invoice capture, approval routing and payment scheduling, and we integrate with the four systems most mid-sized firms already use.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: Set-up is normally twelve hundred pounds. This quarter, we're waiving it for firms processing more than five hundred invoices a month.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: That waiver covers set-up only. Data migration from your old system is quoted separately, and the monthly licence is unchanged.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: Book a demonstration at kestrelledger dot example. Demonstrations run Tuesdays and Thursdays, and take about forty minutes.

questions.prompt: 92. Who qualifies for the waived set-up fee?

options.text: Firms processing more than 500 invoices a month
Firms using one of the four supported systems

questions.explanationVi: 'we're waiving it for firms processing more than five hundred invoices a month'.

questions.prompt: 93. What does the waiver NOT cover?

options.text: Data migration and the monthly licence

questions.explanationVi: 'Data migration from your old system is quoted separately, and the monthly licence is unchanged'.

questions.prompt: 94. When are demonstrations available?
questions.explanationVi: 'Demonstrations run Tuesdays and Thursdays'.

activities.title: Part 4 — Talk 9: with a sales table on the test paper
activities.format: TOEIC Listening — Part 4 · Talk 9, kèm bảng trên đề (câu 95–97)
activities.instructionsVi: Dạng 'Look at the graphic' khó: người nói KHÔNG đọc con số nào, chỉ mô tả bằng thứ hạng và quan hệ.
activities.promptEn:
Listen to the presentation and answer questions 95 through 97. Refer to the table below where indicated.

REGIONAL SALES, Q3 (£m)
North — 12.4
South — 8.9
East — 15.1
West — 9.7

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Thanks. Headlines only; we'll go into detail in the breakouts.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: The quarter came in slightly ahead of plan overall, but the regional picture is uneven and that's what needs a decision today.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Our strongest region is performing well and I'm not going to spend time on it, because nothing there requires anything from this group.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: The one I want to discuss is the region that came in lowest. That result is not a surprise — we closed two depots there in June — but the recovery has been slower than the model predicted. We now think the second half of next year is realistic, rather than the first.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: One caveat before questions. The figures in front of you exclude the Meridian acquisition, which completed in August. Including it would add roughly two million to the eastern total, so please don't quote these externally without that note.

questions.prompt: 95. Look at the graphic. Which region does the speaker want to discuss?
questions.explanationVi: Vùng có kết quả THẤP NHẤT là South (8,9). Con số không được đọc ra, phải tự tra bảng.

questions.prompt: 96. Why does the speaker skip the strongest region?

options.text: No decision is required from this group about it.

questions.explanationVi: 'nothing there requires anything from this group'.

questions.prompt: 97. What caveat is given?

options.text: The figures exclude an acquisition worth about £2m in the East.
The figures include an August acquisition.
The figures are provisional and will be restated.

questions.explanationVi: 'The figures… exclude the Meridian acquisition… would add roughly two million to the eastern total'. Chú ý 'exclude', dễ nghe nhầm thành 'include'.

activities.title: Part 4 — Talk 10: closing remarks at a review meeting
activities.instructionsVi: Bài cuối của Listening. Người nói phân biệt hai khái niệm dễ bị gộp và rút ra một kết luận có điều kiện.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the closing remarks and answer questions 98 through 100.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Before we finish, one observation about how we've been reading the complaint data.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Complaints are up eighteen per cent. Everyone in this room has treated that as bad news, and I want to separate two things that have been getting merged.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: One is whether more things are going wrong. The other is whether more people are telling us. We introduced the in-app reporting button in February, and the rise starts in February.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: So it is quite possible that the underlying failure rate hasn't moved at all and we're simply hearing about more of it — which, if true, is good news wearing a bad disguise.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: The action I want is to compare complaint volume against warranty claims, which are recorded independently of the button. If warranty claims are flat, we have our answer.

questions.prompt: 98. What two things does the speaker separate?

options.text: More failures occurring, and more failures being reported

questions.explanationVi: 'One is whether more things are going wrong. The other is whether more people are telling us'.

questions.prompt: 99. What does the speaker mean by 'good news wearing a bad disguise'?

options.text: The complaint data has been falsified.
Complaints will fall again next quarter.
The reporting button should be removed.
A rise in complaints may reflect better reporting, not worse quality.

questions.explanationVi: Nếu tỉ lệ hỏng không đổi mà chỉ có nhiều người phản ánh hơn, thì con số tăng thực ra là dấu hiệu tốt.

questions.prompt: 100. What action does the speaker request?
questions.explanationVi: 'compare complaint volume against warranty claims, which are recorded independently of the button'.

activities.title: Part 5 — Incomplete Sentences
activities.format: TOEIC Reading — Part 5 · Incomplete Sentences, 30 câu (101–130)
activities.instructionsVi: Ở mục tiêu 800, Part 5 dùng từ vựng hợp đồng, tài chính và một số cấu trúc đảo ngữ. Vẫn 18 giây một câu — tốc độ quan trọng ngang độ chính xác vì Part 7 rất dài.
activities.promptEn: Select the best word or phrase to complete each sentence.
activities.passage:
101. The agreement ______ that all changes must be confirmed in writing within five working days.
102. Cancellations made inside 48 hours will ______ a charge equal to half the fee.
103. The auditor identified a significant ______ between the stock records and the physical count.
104. Management has decided to ______ the expansion until the third quarter results are known.
105. ______ of the two suppliers was able to guarantee delivery before month end.
106. ______ clause 12, either party may terminate immediately in the event of insolvency.
107. Deposits are non-refundable; late cancellations ______ the full amount paid.
108. Rarely ______ the committee overturned a recommendation from the technical panel.
109. The service fee will be ______ if the contract begins part way through a billing period.
110. Matters of staff discipline fall outside the ______ of this working group.
111. The supplier shall ______ the client against any third-party claims arising from the works.
112. The findings should be treated as ______ until the full audit is complete.
113. Reporting requirements proved unduly ______ for the smaller contractors.
114. This agreement ______ all previous arrangements between the parties.
115. Unresolved tickets are automatically ______ to the account manager after 48 hours.
116. Headcount fell through natural ______ rather than redundancy.
117. Payment of the bonus is ______ on meeting the annual target.
118. Large datasets can produce ______ correlations purely by chance.
119. The most ______ point is not the cost but who bears it.
120. The practice is deeply ______ in the profession's training.
121. It is risky to ______ from a single cohort to the whole population.
122. The finding comes with an important ______ about sample size.
123. The paper challenged an ______ that had stood for forty years.
124. Accounts are ______ against bank statements every month.
125. The company was unable to ______ speed with thoroughness.
126. The thirty-day limit is essentially ______ .
127. Moving to the new site would ______ retraining half the workforce.
128. The figures do not hold up under close ______ .
129. Existing operators have a ______ interest in keeping entry difficult.
130. The cost of retrofitting older buildings is often ______ .

questions.prompt: 101. The agreement ______ that all changes must be confirmed in writing within five working days.
questions.explanationVi: 'stipulate' = quy định rõ trong văn bản. Ba phương án còn lại gần giống hình thức nhưng khác hẳn nghĩa.

questions.prompt: 102. Cancellations made inside 48 hours will ______ a charge equal to half the fee.
questions.explanationVi: 'incur a charge' = phải chịu một khoản phí. 'occur' là nội động từ, không có tân ngữ.

questions.prompt: 103. The auditor identified a significant ______ between the stock records and the physical count.
questions.explanationVi: 'discrepancy' là chênh lệch giữa hai thứ LẼ RA phải khớp. 'distinction' là phân biệt có chủ ý.

questions.prompt: 104. Management has decided to ______ the expansion until the third quarter results are known.
questions.explanationVi: 'defer' = hoãn tới thời điểm sau, khớp với 'until'.

questions.prompt: 105. ______ of the two suppliers was able to guarantee delivery before month end.
questions.explanationVi: 'Neither' dùng cho HAI đối tượng và đi với động từ số ít 'was'. 'None' dùng cho ba trở lên.

questions.prompt: 106. ______ clause 12, either party may terminate immediately in the event of insolvency.
questions.explanationVi: 'Notwithstanding' là giới từ, đi thẳng với cụm danh từ. 'Nevertheless' và 'Moreover' là trạng từ nối câu.

questions.prompt: 107. Deposits are non-refundable; late cancellations ______ the full amount paid.
questions.explanationVi: 'forfeit' = mất do vi phạm quy định. 'forgo' là tự nguyện từ bỏ, khác sắc thái bắt buộc.

questions.prompt: 108. Rarely ______ the committee overturned a recommendation from the technical panel.
questions.explanationVi: Trạng từ phủ định đứng đầu câu gây đảo ngữ; 'overturned' là quá khứ phân từ nên cần 'has' cho chủ ngữ số ít.

questions.prompt: 109. The service fee will be ______ if the contract begins part way through a billing period.
questions.explanationVi: 'prorated' = tính theo tỉ lệ thời gian thực dùng.

questions.prompt: 110. Matters of staff discipline fall outside the ______ of this working group.
questions.explanationVi: 'remit' = phạm vi trách nhiệm. 'remittance' là khoản tiền chuyển — bẫy cùng gốc từ.

questions.prompt: 111. The supplier shall ______ the client against any third-party claims arising from the works.
questions.explanationVi: 'indemnify against' = bồi thường, bảo đảm không chịu thiệt hại. Cụm cố định trong hợp đồng.

questions.prompt: 112. The findings should be treated as ______ until the full audit is complete.
questions.explanationVi: 'provisional' = tạm thời, chưa chính thức, khớp với 'until… complete'.

questions.prompt: 113. Reporting requirements proved unduly ______ for the smaller contractors.
questions.explanationVi: 'onerous' = nặng nề, gây gánh nặng. Ba phương án kia chỉ giống về vần.

questions.prompt: 114. This agreement ______ all previous arrangements between the parties.
questions.explanationVi: 'supersede' = thay thế và làm mất hiệu lực cái cũ. 'supplement' là bổ sung mà cái cũ vẫn còn hiệu lực.

questions.prompt: 115. Unresolved tickets are automatically ______ to the account manager after 48 hours.
questions.explanationVi: 'escalate to' = chuyển lên cấp cao hơn.

questions.prompt: 116. Headcount fell through natural ______ rather than redundancy.
questions.explanationVi: 'natural attrition' = hao hụt nhân sự tự nhiên, cụm cố định đối lập với 'redundancy'.

questions.prompt: 117. Payment of the bonus is ______ on meeting the annual target.
questions.explanationVi: 'contingent on' = phụ thuộc vào điều kiện.

questions.prompt: 118. Large datasets can produce ______ correlations purely by chance.
questions.explanationVi: 'spurious correlation' = tương quan giả, cụm chuẩn trong thống kê.

questions.prompt: 119. The most ______ point is not the cost but who bears it.
questions.explanationVi: 'salient' = nổi bật, đáng chú ý nhất.

questions.prompt: 120. The practice is deeply ______ in the profession's training.
questions.explanationVi: 'deeply entrenched' = ăn sâu, khó thay đổi. Cụm cố định.

questions.prompt: 121. It is risky to ______ from a single cohort to the whole population.
questions.explanationVi: 'extrapolate from X to Y' = ngoại suy từ mẫu nhỏ ra tổng thể.

questions.prompt: 122. The finding comes with an important ______ about sample size.
questions.explanationVi: 'caveat' = lưu ý dè dặt, điều kiện cảnh báo kèm theo kết luận.

questions.prompt: 123. The paper challenged an ______ that had stood for forty years.
questions.explanationVi: 'orthodoxy' = quan điểm chính thống được số đông chấp nhận.

questions.prompt: 124. Accounts are ______ against bank statements every month.
questions.explanationVi: 'reconcile against' = đối chiếu cho khớp, thuật ngữ kế toán chuẩn.

questions.prompt: 125. The company was unable to ______ speed with thoroughness.
questions.explanationVi: 'reconcile A with B' cũng có nghĩa dung hoà hai thứ đối lập — cùng động từ nhưng nghĩa khác câu 124.

questions.prompt: 126. The thirty-day limit is essentially ______ .
questions.explanationVi: Sau 'is essentially' cần tính từ. 'arbitrary' = tuỳ tiện, không có căn cứ rõ.

questions.prompt: 127. Moving to the new site would ______ retraining half the workforce.
questions.explanationVi: 'entail' = kéo theo như một phần tất yếu. 'entitle' là trao quyền, đảo ngược sắc thái gánh nặng.

questions.prompt: 128. The figures do not hold up under close ______ .
questions.explanationVi: Sau giới từ 'under' và tính từ 'close' cần danh từ. 'under close scrutiny' là cụm cố định.

questions.prompt: 129. Existing operators have a ______ interest in keeping entry difficult.
questions.explanationVi: 'vested interest' = lợi ích riêng gắn liền, cụm cố định.

questions.prompt: 130. The cost of retrofitting older buildings is often ______ .
questions.explanationVi: 'prohibitive' = cao tới mức không kham nổi. 'prohibited' nghĩa là bị cấm — khác hẳn dù cùng gốc.

activities.title: Part 6 — Text 1: notice of revised terms
activities.instructionsVi: Văn bản pháp lý ngắn nhưng dày. Câu chèn ở mức này thường có hai phương án đều hợp ngữ cảnh; chọn câu nối được cả câu trước lẫn câu sau.
activities.promptEn: Read the notice and choose the best option for each numbered blank.
activities.passage:
NOTICE TO ACCOUNT HOLDERS — Revised Service Terms

We are writing to inform you of changes to our terms of service, effective 1 September. These terms (131) ______ the version issued in March 2023.

The principal change concerns escalation. Support requests unresolved after 48 hours will now be referred automatically to a named account manager. (132) ______

We are also clarifying the position on planned maintenance. Scheduled downtime notified at least seven days in advance will not count towards the availability guarantee. Unplanned downtime will continue to count in full, and credits will be applied on a (133) ______ basis according to the hours affected.

If you do not wish to accept the revised terms, you may terminate without penalty by writing to us before 31 August. (134) ______ that date, continued use of the service will be taken as acceptance.

questions.explanationVi: Điều khoản mới THAY THẾ bản cũ và làm bản cũ hết hiệu lực. 'supplement' là bổ sung mà bản cũ vẫn còn hiệu lực — bẫy chính.

questions.prompt: 132. — chọn câu phù hợp nhất để chèn vào

options.text: Support requests must now be submitted by telephone.
Previously, escalation depended on the customer requesting it.
Account managers will no longer be assigned.

questions.explanationVi: Câu trước nhấn mạnh từ 'automatically', nên câu chèn hợp lý là nêu tình trạng cũ để làm rõ thay đổi. (C) và (D) mâu thuẫn trực tiếp.
Trước danh từ 'basis' cần tính từ; phân từ quá khứ 'prorated' làm chức năng đó.
'Beyond that date' = sau mốc thời gian đó. 'Within' nghĩa ngược lại, làm hỏng logic.

activities.title: Part 6 — Text 2: internal memo on expenses
activities.instructionsVi: Bản ghi nhớ dài, chỗ trống phụ thuộc vào thông tin cách đó hai, ba câu. Đọc hết đoạn trước khi quyết định.
activities.promptEn: Read the memo and choose the best option for each numbered blank.
activities.passage:
MEMORANDUM
To: All staff
From: Finance
Subject: Revised expenses policy, effective 1 November

Following last month's review, we are making three changes.

First, all claims must be submitted through the online portal. Paper forms will no longer be (135) ______ after 31 October, including for claims relating to earlier months.

Second, receipts are required for every item regardless of value. Previously, items under fifteen dollars needed no documentation. (136) ______

Third, claims must be submitted within sixty days of the expense being (137) ______ . Later claims will be considered only in exceptional circumstances and must be approved by a department head.

We recognise these changes add administrative work. They were introduced (138) ______ an audit finding that the previous system could not reliably match claims to business purposes.

questions.explanationVi: 'no longer be accepted' = không còn được chấp nhận. 'excepted' (loại trừ) và 'expected' là bẫy gần âm.

questions.prompt: 136. — chọn câu phù hợp nhất để chèn vào

options.text: The threshold has been raised to fifty dollars.
Receipts should be posted to Finance.
Staff may now claim without documentation.

questions.explanationVi: Câu trước nói trước đây dưới 15 đô không cần chứng từ, quy định mới yêu cầu mọi khoản đều cần — nên câu chèn phải xác nhận ngoại lệ đó đã bị bỏ.
'the expense being incurred' — dạng bị động sau 'being'. Chi phí là thứ BỊ phát sinh.
Thay đổi được đưa ra ĐỂ ĐÁP LẠI phát hiện kiểm toán — quan hệ nguyên nhân.

activities.title: Part 6 — Text 3: letter about a tender outcome
activities.instructionsVi: Thư thông báo kết quả đấu thầu. Giọng trang trọng, nhiều cụm cố định và một câu chèn mang tính an ủi.
activities.promptEn: Read the letter and choose the best option for each numbered blank.
activities.passage:
Dear Mr Okafor,

Thank you for your tender for the Kirby depot maintenance contract.

After careful evaluation, I regret to inform you that your submission was not successful on this occasion. The panel scored all six tenders against price, technical capability and social value, and yours placed third.

Your technical response was among the strongest we received, and the panel commented particularly on your proposed response times. (139) ______

The decisive difference was price, where the (140) ______ bid was approximately eleven per cent below yours.

We would (141) ______ you to tender for future opportunities. Our forward plan is published each January and lists contracts coming to market in the following eighteen months.

If you would like detailed feedback, please contact me before 30 June, (142) ______ which point the evaluation papers are archived.

Yours sincerely,
Ina Duarte
Procurement Manager

questions.prompt: 139. — chọn câu phù hợp nhất để chèn vào

options.text: Unfortunately your technical response did not meet the minimum standard.
No feedback on technical matters is available.
The panel did not score technical capability.
It was not, therefore, the technical element that decided the outcome.

questions.explanationVi: Câu trước khen phần kỹ thuật, câu sau nói giá mới là yếu tố quyết định — câu chèn phải bắc cầu giữa hai ý đó. (A), (B) và (C) đều mâu thuẫn với văn bản.
Cần tính từ đứng trước 'bid'. Phân từ hiện tại 'winning' làm chức năng đó: hồ sơ thắng thầu.
Câu tiếp theo giới thiệu kế hoạch đấu thầu tương lai, nên ý ở đây là mời tham gia tiếp. (A) và (D) đảo ngược ý.
'after which point' = sau thời điểm đó thì hồ sơ được lưu trữ. Cụm quan hệ chỉ thời gian.

activities.title: Part 6 — Text 4: article on remote working policy
activities.instructionsVi: Bài báo có lập luận hai chiều. Câu chèn phải giữ đúng mạch tranh luận, không được đảo chiều.
activities.promptEn: Read the article and choose the best option for each numbered blank.
activities.passage:
FAIRPORT — Three years after most local employers adopted hybrid working, the picture is more (143) ______ than either side of the argument predicted.

Office attendance across the town's largest employers has settled at around sixty per cent of pre-2020 levels and has not moved since 2023. Retail spending in the centre, however, fell by only fifteen per cent, and evening trade has grown.

(144) ______ The pattern of demand shifted rather than disappearing.

Employers report a similar split. Those who mandated a full return have not, on the whole, seen the productivity gains they expected, (145) ______ several have recorded higher turnover among staff with caring responsibilities.

What most managers now describe as decisive is not the number of days in the office but whether those days are (146) ______ — that is, whether the team is present at the same time.

questions.explanationVi: Sau 'more' và trước 'than' cần tính từ. 'mixed' = phức tạp, không rõ ràng một chiều.

questions.prompt: 144. — chọn câu phù hợp nhất để chèn vào

options.text: Weekday lunch trade declined, but weekend and evening visits rose.
Retail spending collapsed across every category.
Office attendance has returned to previous levels.
No data on retail spending is available.

questions.explanationVi: Câu sau nói 'The pattern of demand shifted rather than disappearing', nên câu chèn phải mô tả sự dịch chuyển đó. (B), (C), (D) đều mâu thuẫn với đoạn trên.
Hai vế cùng chiều: không được lợi như kỳ vọng, VÀ còn mất người. 'but' sẽ đảo chiều lập luận.
Sau 'are' cần tính từ, và mệnh đề giải thích ngay sau ('the team is present at the same time') xác nhận nghĩa 'được sắp trùng nhau'.

activities.title: Part 7 — Single passage 1: text message chain
activities.instructionsVi: Chuỗi tin nhắn, có một câu hỏi hàm ý về một câu nói cụ thể.
activities.promptEn: Refer to the following text message chain and answer the questions.
activities.passage:
Priya Nair (11:02 a.m.)

PROCEDURE — Responding to a suspected data breach

1. Contain first, investigate second. Disconnect the affected system from the network. Do not switch it off — powering down destroys evidence held in memory.
2. Notify the Data Protection Officer within one hour of discovery. This applies even if you believe the breach is minor; the assessment of severity is not yours to make.

activities.promptEn: Refer to the following procedure, incident log and email, then answer the questions.
activities.passage:
PROCEDURE — Data breach response (extract)

1. Disconnect the affected system from the network. Do not power it down.
2. Notify the Data Protection Officer within one hour of discovery.
3. Preserve all logs; delete nothing.
4. Do not contact affected individuals directly.
5. The regulator must be notified within 72 hours of discovery where there is a risk to individuals.

---

INCIDENT LOG — Ref BR-114

09:12 Tue — Unusual outbound traffic noticed on server FS-2 by night supervisor.
09:20 Tue — Server disconnected from network. Left powered on.
09:55 Tue — DPO notified.
11:30 Tue — Supervisor emailed three customers whose files appeared in the traffic, advising them to change passwords.
14:00 Wed — Forensic review begins.
16:20 Thu — Review concludes: 240 customer records exposed.

---

EMAIL
From: dpo@meridianhouse.example
To: site-managers@meridianhouse.example
Date: Friday
Subject: BR-114 — lessons

Colleagues,

The technical handling of BR-114 was good. Containment was fast, the server was left powered on, and I was notified inside the hour.

One action was outside procedure and I want to be clear about why it matters. Contacting the three customers directly was well intentioned, but notification is made centrally for a reason: an informal warning that later conflicts with the formal notice damages our credibility and can be treated by the regulator as evidence of a disorganised response.

We notified the regulator on Wednesday afternoon, within the 72-hour window measured from Tuesday morning. Note that the clock runs from discovery, not from the conclusion of the review — had we waited for Thursday's findings, we would have been late.

Ina Duarte, DPO

questions.prompt: 191. Which procedural step was breached?

options.text: Step 1 — the server was powered down.
Step 2 — the DPO was notified late.
Step 5 — the regulator was notified late.

questions.explanationVi: 11:30 thứ Ba: giám sát viên tự gửi email cho ba khách hàng, trái với bước 4. Ba bước kia đều được thực hiện đúng.

questions.prompt: 192. Was the DPO notified within the required time?

options.text: No — it took over two hours.
Yes — but only after the review concluded.

questions.explanationVi: Phát hiện 09:12, báo DPO 09:55 — 43 phút, trong hạn một giờ.

questions.prompt: 193. Why does the DPO say the direct contact matters?

options.text: An informal warning may conflict with the formal notice.

questions.explanationVi: 'an informal warning that later conflicts with the formal notice damages our credibility'.

questions.prompt: 194. Why would waiting for Thursday's findings have been a problem?

options.text: The forensic team would have been unavailable.
The 72-hour clock runs from discovery, not from the review.
The server would have been powered down.

questions.explanationVi: 'the clock runs from discovery, not from the conclusion of the review — had we waited for Thursday's findings, we would have been late'.

questions.prompt: 195. What is the DPO's overall assessment?

options.text: The technical handling was good but one action was outside procedure.

questions.explanationVi: 'The technical handling of BR-114 was good… One action was outside procedure'.

activities.title: Part 7 — Triple passage 3: price list, order and credit note
activities.instructionsVi: Bộ ba văn bản cuối. Có hai phép tính nhiều bước và một câu hỏi về thứ tự áp dụng chiết khấu.
activities.promptEn: Refer to the following price list, order and credit note, then answer the questions.
activities.passage:
PRICE LIST — Northline Components (trade)

Bracket A — £2.40 each
Bracket B — £3.10 each
Bracket C — £4.75 each

Volume discount: 5% on orders of more than 600 bracket units in total.
Loyalty discount: a further 3% for accounts open more than five years, applied after the volume discount.
Carriage: standard £0; express £85. Discounts do not apply to carriage.

---

ORDER PO-3310 — Delta Manufacturing (account opened 2016)

Bracket A — 500 units
Bracket B — 200 units
Carriage — standard
Requested delivery: 20 May

---

CREDIT NOTE CN-441 — issued 26 May

Against invoice 9014 for PO-3310.

Reason: 40 units of Bracket B arrived damaged and were returned on 24 May. Credit is calculated at the unit price actually charged, that is, after both discounts.

Credit: £114.28
Note: carriage was not charged on this order, so no adjustment to carriage is required.

questions.prompt: 196. Does the order qualify for the volume discount?

options.text: No — only 500 units of one type
Only if express carriage is used

questions.explanationVi: 500 + 200 = 700, vượt ngưỡng 600. Ngưỡng tính trên TỔNG số đơn vị bracket, không tính riêng từng loại.

questions.prompt: 197. Does the account qualify for the loyalty discount?

options.text: Yes — the account was opened in 2016.
No — it must be open ten years.
No — it applies only to Bracket C.

questions.explanationVi: Tài khoản mở năm 2016, hơn năm năm tính tới thời điểm đơn hàng.

questions.prompt: 198. In what order are the discounts applied?

options.text: Both applied to the original price and added together
Only the larger of the two applies.

questions.explanationVi: 'a further 3%… applied after the volume discount'. Thứ tự này thay đổi kết quả cuối cùng.

questions.prompt: 199. Approximately what unit price was used for the credit on Bracket B?
questions.explanationVi: £114,28 ÷ 40 = £2,857 → làm tròn £2,86. Kiểm chứng: £3,10 × 0,95 (giảm số lượng, vì 500 + 200 = 700 > 600 đơn vị) × 0,97 (giảm khách quen) = £2,857. Các phương án nhiễu là giá chưa giảm (£3,10), chỉ giảm 5% (£2,95) và chỉ giảm 3% (£3,01).

questions.prompt: 200. Why is no carriage adjustment required?

options.text: Standard carriage was used and cost nothing.
The goods were collected by the customer.

questions.explanationVi: Đơn dùng carriage tiêu chuẩn (£0), nên không có gì để điều chỉnh — credit note nói rõ điều này.

activities.title: Writing Q6–7 — Respond to a written request
activities.format: TOEIC Writing — Respond to a Written Request · 10 phút, email đàm phán
activities.instructionsVi: Viết 70–140 từ. Ở mức này đề yêu cầu vừa từ chối một phần vừa giữ quan hệ. Phải làm đủ ba việc mà không nghe cứng nhắc hay nhượng bộ hết.
activities.promptEn:
Read the email below and respond.

From: Yusuf Kaya, Procurement Manager, Delta Manufacturing
To: Sales, Northline Components
Subject: Price increase notification

We received your letter advising a 9% price increase from January. Given that we have ordered from you for six years and our volumes rose 20% last year, we consider this increase difficult to accept. Please explain the reason for it and tell us what flexibility is available.

---

DIRECTIONS: Respond as the sales representative. In your reply, explain ONE reason for the increase, offer ONE form of flexibility, and ask ONE question.
activities.sampleAnswer:
Dear Mr Kaya,

Thank you for writing, and I appreciate the length of our working relationship.

The increase reflects the cost of raw copper, which has risen by more than twenty per cent since last January. We have absorbed that cost for three quarters and can no longer do so without affecting the quality standards you rely on.

I can, however, offer some flexibility. Given your increased volumes, I am able to apply a tiered rate: orders above 5,000 units would be charged at a 4% increase rather than 9%, which for your current pattern would reduce the overall effect considerably.

Could you tell me whether you expect your volumes to remain at last year's level in the coming year? If so, I can prepare a firm twelve-month quotation on that basis.

Best regards,
Lena Fischer
Northline Components
rubricVi: Làm đủ ba việc: nêu MỘT lý do, đưa MỘT hình thức linh hoạt, hỏi MỘT câu. Đây vẫn là tiêu chí chấm số một.
Lý do phải cụ thể và kiểm chứng được (giá đồng tăng hơn 20%), không nói chung chung 'chi phí tăng'.
Hình thức linh hoạt phải là nhượng bộ THẬT, có con số. Nói 'chúng tôi sẽ xem xét' không tính là nhượng bộ.
Ghi nhận quan hệ lâu năm mà khách nêu ra. Bỏ qua chi tiết khách đưa là lỗi nội dung.
Giữ giọng chuyên nghiệp, không xin lỗi quá mức cũng không phòng thủ. 70–140 từ là vừa.

activities.title: Writing Q8 — Write an opinion essay
activities.format: TOEIC Writing — Opinion Essay · 30 phút, tối thiểu 300 từ
activities.instructionsVi: Viết 300–380 từ. Đề ở mức này có hai vế đối lập cụ thể, nên bài phải so sánh trực tiếp chứ không chỉ ca ngợi một bên. Vẫn giữ cấu trúc rõ ràng kiểu TOEIC.
activities.promptEn:
Do you agree or disagree with the following statement?

'When a company must reduce costs, it is better to cut spending on marketing than to reduce the number of employees.'

Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
activities.sampleAnswer:
I agree that a company facing cost pressure should reduce marketing spending before reducing staff numbers. I hold this view for three reasons: marketing cuts are reversible, staff cuts damage capability, and redundancies carry hidden costs that are often underestimated.

First, a marketing budget can be reduced and restored quickly. If a company suspends an advertising campaign for two quarters and conditions improve, it can restart almost immediately. Rebuilding a team is entirely different. A colleague of mine worked for a software firm that cut its support department by a third during a downturn; when demand recovered eight months later, hiring and training replacements took nearly a year, and the company lost two major clients in the meantime because response times had collapsed.

Second, employees carry knowledge that does not exist anywhere else. Marketing materials can be recreated from files, but an experienced technician's understanding of which machines fail in which conditions is not written down. When that person leaves, the company does not simply lose one worker; it loses the accumulated judgement that made the work efficient. This is especially damaging in small firms, where a single person may be the only one who understands a particular process.

Third, redundancies are more expensive than they appear. There are severance payments, legal costs, and a measurable fall in productivity among the staff who remain, because people who fear losing their jobs spend a considerable amount of time worrying about it. Several studies have found that output drops for months after a redundancy programme, which partly cancels the intended saving.

I would add one qualification. If a company's marketing is genuinely generating more revenue than it costs, cutting it will worsen the financial position rather than improve it. In that situation the correct response is to cut elsewhere.

In conclusion, I believe reducing marketing is usually the better first step, because it is reversible, it preserves capability, and it avoids costs that redundancy programmes tend to hide.
rubricVi: So sánh TRỰC TIẾP hai phương án mà đề nêu. Bài chỉ nói 'cắt nhân sự là xấu' mà không nhắc marketing là chưa trả lời đúng đề.
Đúng ba lý do, mỗi lý do một đoạn, mỗi đoạn có ví dụ cụ thể có chi tiết định lượng.
Nêu một điều kiện giới hạn cho lập trường của mình. Ở mức 800, bài một chiều hoàn toàn bị đánh giá là thiếu chín chắn.
Từ nối rõ ràng và câu chủ đề đứng đầu mỗi đoạn. TOEIC chấm cấu trúc chặt hơn IELTS.
Đủ 300 từ, kết bài nhắc lại đủ ba lý do bằng cách diễn đạt khác, không chép lại nguyên câu mở bài.

activities.title: Speaking Q3 — Describe a picture
activities.format: TOEIC Speaking — Describe a Picture · 45 giây chuẩn bị, 45 giây nói
activities.instructionsVi: Cảnh ở mức này có nhiều lớp và một chi tiết bất thường. Người chấm mong bạn nêu được cả bố cục lẫn chi tiết đáng chú ý, không chỉ liệt kê người và vật.
activities.promptEn:
Describe the scene below in as much detail as you can. You have 45 seconds to prepare and 45 seconds to speak.

SCENE: A distribution warehouse. In the foreground, two workers in high-visibility vests and hard hats are loading sealed boxes onto a wheeled trolley; one is checking items against a tablet. Behind them, tall metal shelving units stretch into the distance, stacked with pallets. On the left, a forklift truck is lifting a pallet to an upper shelf, and a third worker is standing well back, watching. A yellow line is painted on the floor separating the walking area from the vehicle area. High windows near the ceiling provide most of the light.
activities.sampleAnswer:
This picture shows the inside of a large distribution warehouse, and it looks like a busy working environment.

In the foreground, two workers are loading sealed boxes onto a wheeled trolley. Both of them are wearing high-visibility vests and hard hats, and one of them is checking the items against a tablet, so they are probably recording what is being moved.

Behind them, I can see tall metal shelving units that stretch into the distance. They are stacked with pallets, which suggests the warehouse is close to full.

On the left-hand side, a forklift truck is lifting a pallet up to one of the higher shelves. A third worker is standing well back and watching, which is what safety procedures would require.

One detail I noticed is a yellow line painted on the floor. It appears to separate the area where people walk from the area where vehicles operate. The light comes mainly from high windows near the ceiling.
rubricVi: Nêu được chi tiết có ý nghĩa (vạch vàng phân làn, người đứng lùi ra xa) chứ không chỉ đếm người. Ở mức 800 đây là điểm phân biệt.
Giải thích chức năng của chi tiết bằng ngôn ngữ phỏng đoán: 'which suggests', 'it appears to'.
Trật tự không gian rõ ràng: tiền cảnh → hậu cảnh → bên trái → chi tiết → ánh sáng.
Hiện tại tiếp diễn cho mọi hành động đang diễn ra, dùng liên tục và chính xác.
Dùng hết 45 giây. Nếu còn thời gian, thêm một câu về ấn tượng chung của bức ảnh.

activities.title: Speaking Q7–9 — Respond using information provided
activities.format: TOEIC Speaking — Respond Using Information Provided · 30 giây đọc bảng
activities.instructionsVi: Ở mức này bảng có nhiều cột hơn và câu hỏi thứ hai thường chứa thông tin sai cần đính chính. Đọc kỹ 30 giây, đặc biệt là các dòng có giờ trùng nhau.
activities.promptEn:
You have 30 seconds to read the programme below. Then answer the three questions using the information given.

NORTHERN SUPPLY CHAIN FORUM — 22 May, Delaney Hotel

09:15–10:00  Opening keynote: 'Resilience after disruption' — Dr Amina Sesay (Grand Hall)
10:15–11:15  Panel: Warehouse automation — moderated by Tomas Berg (Grand Hall)
11:15–11:45  Coffee
11:45–12:45  Workshop A: Supplier risk assessment — Dr Amina Sesay (Room 3)
11:45–12:45  Workshop B: Customs documentation — Priya Nair (Room 4)
12:45–14:00  Lunch (Terrace Restaurant)
14:00–15:30  Case study session — Tomas Berg (Grand Hall)

Note: Workshops A and B run at the same time. Delegates must choose one.

Questions:
1. What time does the forum start, and who gives the opening talk?
2. I'd like to attend both workshops — can I do that?
3. Could you tell me everything Tomas Berg is involved in?
activities.sampleAnswer:
1. The forum starts at nine fifteen in the morning, and the opening keynote is given by Dr Amina Sesay. It's called 'Resilience after disruption' and it takes place in the Grand Hall.

2. I'm afraid that isn't possible. Workshops A and B both run from eleven forty-five to twelve forty-five, so they overlap completely. You will need to choose one of the two.

3. Of course. Tomas Berg is involved in two sessions. First, he moderates the panel on warehouse automation, which runs from ten fifteen to eleven fifteen in the Grand Hall. Second, he leads the case study session in the afternoon, from two o'clock until half past three, also in the Grand Hall.
rubricVi: Câu 2 là thông tin sai cần đính chính. Phải nói rõ không thể và GIẢI THÍCH vì sao (trùng giờ), không chỉ trả lời 'no'.
Câu 3 phải liệt kê đủ cả hai phiên của người được hỏi, kèm giờ và phòng. Thiếu một phiên là mất điểm.
Đọc giờ tự nhiên: 'nine fifteen', 'half past three'.
Dùng cụm giảm nhẹ khi báo tin không thuận: 'I'm afraid that isn't possible'. Đây là ngôn ngữ dịch vụ khách hàng mà TOEIC đánh giá cao.
Chỉ dùng thông tin trong bảng, không thêm bớt.

activities.title: Speaking Q10 — Propose a solution
activities.format: TOEIC Speaking — Propose a Solution · 30 giây chuẩn bị, 60 giây nói
activities.instructionsVi: Vấn đề ở mức này có hai mặt cùng lúc, và giải pháp phải xử lý cả hai. Cấu trúc: xác nhận vấn đề đầy đủ → giải pháp → bước tiếp theo.
activities.promptEn:
Listen to the voicemail describing a problem, then leave a message proposing a solution.

VOICEMAIL: 'Hello, this is Marcus Feld, the shift supervisor at the Eastgate site. Two things. First, three of my night staff have handed in notice this week, all on the same day, and I'm now short-staffed from the fifteenth. Second, when I asked them why, all three mentioned the new shift-swap system — apparently they can't get swaps approved in time and they've been refused leave twice. I think these two things are connected. I need to know what support I can get. My number is 0161 288 4470.'
activities.sampleAnswer:
Hello Marcus, this is Ngozi Eze from HR, returning your call.

Thank you for flagging this. To confirm I've understood: you have three night staff leaving from the fifteenth, which leaves you short-staffed, and all three cited the new shift-swap system, having been refused leave twice. I agree those two things are very likely connected.

Here's what I propose. For the immediate gap, I'll release agency cover for the night shift from the fifteenth for four weeks, which gives us time to recruit properly rather than rushing it. For the underlying cause, I'd like to suspend the automatic refusal rule in the swap system while we review it, so your remaining staff don't hit the same problem in the meantime.

I'll also want to speak to the three leavers before they finish, if they're willing. Could you call me back today to confirm the agency shift pattern you need? I'm on this number until six.
rubricVi: Nhắc lại ĐỦ CẢ HAI vấn đề trước khi đề xuất. Bỏ một mặt là mất điểm hoàn thành nhiệm vụ.
Giải pháp phải xử lý cả hai: bù người trước mắt VÀ sửa nguyên nhân gốc. Chỉ giải quyết một mặt là chưa đủ ở mức này.
Nêu bước tiếp theo cụ thể có mốc thời gian ('gọi lại hôm nay', 'tôi trực tới sáu giờ').
Xưng tên và bộ phận ngay đầu tin nhắn.
Dùng hết 60 giây với nhịp đều. Cấu trúc ba phần giúp không bị hụt hơi ở cuối.
